name: Wanted Streets: Open World Crime
summary:
Start at home. Step into the city. Decide how far you'll go.

Wanted Streets: Open World Crime brings open-world freedom to VR with city exploration, car driving, weapon combat, and missions that put you on either side of the law.

EXPLORE THE CITY
Leave your house and roam the streets at your own pace. Discover missions marked on the map, get behind the wheel of different cars and vehicles, or simply cruise and explore.
